title: Create: Aero Mekanized
description: This is a modpack based off of the idea of Create: Mekanized that I myself have decided to remake for a newer version, with both a server and client version.
body:
### Create: Aero Mekanized Versions CS/SS
Create: Aero Mekanized has 2 version with one being CS meaning it is for Client Side use and SS which is for Server Side. The SS version is more bare bones with it having no Client Side mods that would mess with Server Side settings or setup.

SS has been tested on a server with multiple people and it has worked fine as long as everyone is using the CS version of the modpack.

### Create: Aero Mekanized Most Important Mods
The mods in this modpack that effect gameplay the most are: [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), [Create: Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics), [Mekansim](https://modrinth.com/mod/mekanism), [Biomes O' Plenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty), [TaCZ Neoforge port](https://modrinth.com/mod/tacz-1.21.1), [Create: Northstar - Redux](https://modrinth.com/mod/northstar-redux), [GraveStone Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/gravestone-mod).

### Shader Recommended
[Complementry reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined)
### Up to date
Create: Aero Mekanized is up to date with the newest versions of all mods as long as the newer versions are stable with the rest of the modpack. updates may take some time due to time restraints or other reasons such as mod incompatabilities and also due to me working on this by myself.

### Open development
Create: Aero Mekanized is open-source, and so are most of its mods.
